description: This file is a header file declaring functions related to URL parsing in the lighttpd web server project. It includes function prototypes for parsing raw URLs, paths, and hostnames, as well as related descriptions and include directives.

methods.name: li_parse_raw_url
methods.description: Parses the raw URI string into its components; must be initialized before use.

methods.name: li_parse_raw_path
methods.description: Parses an input string into URI components such as path and query, with decoding and path simplification.

methods.name: li_parse_hostname
methods.description: Parses the hostname from the URI.
